title: Review locally first: the CodeRabbit CLI has its own allowance
description: CodeRabbit PR reviews are rate limited per GitHub identity with an adaptive refill that bottoms out at 1 per hour, and every push to an open PR spends one. create-pr now runs the CodeRabbit CLI against the branch diff before gh pr create, on a separate allowance. Slide the usage and push counts, and step through how the phase degrades when the CLI is missing, signed out, or slow.
